title: Reparar dedupe terminal en frontier-pressure compiler
mission: Repair frontier-pressure computation so the stable portfolio dedupe law is enforced across different job_id rows sharing one dedupe_key. A terminal return for a dedupe_key must block replay of every ready job carrying that dedupe_key, and duplicate ready rows for one dedupe_key must not inflate claimable frontier counts. Preserve recovery/liveness semantics and existing passing tests.
definition_of_done: Terminal return normalization retains dedupe_key where present and frontier computation applies terminal closure by job_id OR dedupe_key.
Multiple ready job_ids sharing one nonterminal dedupe_key contribute at most one claimable unit and cannot bypass a live owner attached to another row in the same dedupe group.
Regression tests cover terminal cross-job dedupe replay, duplicate ready rows, live owner within a dedupe group, and retry-safe replaceable recovery semantics.
Existing frontier-pressure compiler tests continue to pass.
Independent oracle v1.1 scenario terminal_and_duplicate_dedupe_are_excluded matches expected claimable_useful_work=1.
No production /w or Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion is made.
